Correction on present: Display::present 0x5bed3c chooses by the vsync byte [displaySettings(0x15b86b0)+0x30] (default 1 from make_displaySettings): vsync on -> swapchain vtable slot 8 Present(1,0) (ldr [r3,#0x20]); vsync off -> swapchain vtable slot 22 Present1(0,flags,&params) (ldr [r3,#0x58]) with flags 0x200 only if hasFeature(7). So the claim 'Present(1,0) because hasFeature(7) is false' is wrong in cause; hasFeature(7) only gates the tearing flag on the vsync-off branch. Consequence: the pointer stored at display+0x1c must be a real IDXGISwapChain1 if the user ever turns vsync off, and the host's slot-8 Present hook does not see that call. Result codes 2/3 of Present feed releaseDevice.
